# Tutorial gallery artwork

These 11 conceptual illustrations replace the gallery thumbnails only. Scientific result figures remain in the tutorial notebooks.

Generated on 2026-09-13 through the Harvard HUIT Responses API with `gpt-6-astra` (medium reasoning), calling the `gpt-image-2` image-generation tool at medium quality. The collection uses paper relief, gouache shading, a warm paper background, and FuseMap teal with restrained coral, lilac, and ochre accents.

Each master was generated at 1536 × 1024 pixels, visually reviewed, then resized with Pillow Lanczos to a 900 × 600 WebP (quality 90, method 6). `manifest.json` records each tutorial, its concept, the submitted prompt, the tool-revised prompt, and the web asset SHA-256. The images are conceptual artwork and do not depict measured results.

`docs/conf.py` explicitly assigns the 11 illustrations to notebook gallery entries. Card titles provide the accessible link names; their accompanying thumbnail images are decorative.
